Markdown to HTML Converter

Hand-written Markdown parser that renders sanitized HTML: headings, lists, code, tables-free blocks and more.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste Markdown into the input box.
  2. Click Render — the sanitized HTML preview appears below.
  3. Toggle HTML source view to copy the markup.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which Markdown features are supported?

Headings, bold/italic/strikethrough, links, images, ordered/unordered/nested lists, inline code, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, and horizontal rules.

Is the output sanitized?

Yes — all raw HTML is escaped first, and javascript:/data: URLs are blocked, so the preview is safe.

Which Markdown library does it use?

The parser is hand-written in dependency-free JavaScript and runs fully in your browser.

Can I see the raw HTML?

Toggle “Show HTML source” to see and copy the generated markup.
